title: 2120. Execution of All Suffix Instructions Staying in a Grid

examples.explanation: Starting from startPos and beginning execution from the ith instruction: - 0th: "RRDDLU". Only one instruction "R" can be executed before it moves off the grid. - 1st:  "RDDLU". All five instructions can be executed while it stays in the grid and ends at (1, 1). - 2nd:   "DDLU". All four instructions can be executed while it stays in the grid and ends at (1, 0). - 3rd:    "DLU". All three instructions can be executed while it stays in the grid and ends at (0, 0). - 4th:     "LU". Only one instruction "L" can be executed before it moves off the grid. - 5th:      "U". If moving up, it would move off the grid.
No matter which instruction the robot begins execution from, it would move off the grid.
